The get_adsorption_sites_text tool expects a proper CIF with data block header starting with "data_". The original file had "# generated using pymatgen\n_data_Cu2O". The tool likely expects the CIF string without the leading comment line "# generated using pymatgen". Also maybe expects the data block name without leading underscore? Actually typical CIF starts with "data_..." line. The original had "# generated using pymatgen\n_data_Cu2O". The tool gave error "Invalid CIF file with no structures!". Possibly the comment line interferes. Let's try passing the original content but without the comment line and ensure it starts with "data_Cu2O". Already we wrote corrected_slab.cif starting with "data_Cu2O". Let's feed that file content.

We can read corrected_slab.cif and pass to tool.
